prog='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    nonzero = [(r, c, v) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v]
    if not nonzero:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    # Select the diagonal orientation represented by the longest observed stripe.
    buckets = []
    for key_fn in (lambda r, c: c - r, lambda r, c: r + c):
        groups = {}
        for r, c, v in nonzero:
            groups.setdefault(key_fn(r, c), []).append(v)
        buckets.append((max(map(len, groups.values())), key_fn))
    key_fn = max(buckets, key=lambda item: item[0])[1]
    clues = [(key_fn(r, c), v) for r, c, v in nonzero]

    period = next(p for p in range(1, max(h, w) * 2 + 1)
                  if all(not any(k % p == kk % p and v != vv
                                 for kk, vv in clues[:i])
                         for i, (k, v) in enumerate(clues)))
    palette = {}
    for k, v in clues:
        palette[k % period] = v

    # Every residue is represented by the clues in these ARC tasks.
    return [[palette[key_fn(r, c) % period] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
'''

programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p=programs/'task-676f8cb8.py'
p.write_text(prog)
print(p, p.read_text())
